---
name: Evaluator methodology challenge
about: The evaluator's logic or the claim it makes is not proportionate to the evidence.
title: "methodology: "
labels: ["validation", "methodology"]
---

## Check

Which check_id's evaluator logic is being challenged?

## The claim being made

What the finding currently concludes (status, summary, any "coverage"/"healthy"
language).

## Why the methodology is wrong or overstated

Which concept is conflated? Examples from the methodology:

- licensed seats used as a device/population denominator;
- configuration evidence treated as if it proved operational effectiveness;
- a proxy/heuristic treated as direct proof;
- absence of evidence treated as evidence of absence;
- terminology overstating what was measured.

## Proposed change to the claim

How should the finding be worded, or which status/confidence should it carry?

## Supporting evidence

- The Microsoft API/behavior that contradicts the current logic
- Microsoft Learn / SCuBA / standard references

## References

Documentation that supports the corrected methodology.
